citation: James S. Buck, Pioneer History of Milwaukee, vol. 1 (Milwaukee, 1876), early-settlement chronology describing Horace Chase and Joseph Porthier's February-March 1835 travel from Chicago to Milwaukee.
author: James S. Buck
locator: vol. 1, early-settlement chronology for Horace Chase and Joseph Porthier
note: Retrospective local history, but unusually useful here because it gives precise travel dates: Porthier left Chicago February 27, briefly returned for means, left again March 21, and reached Milwaukee March 23. Those dates place his removal before the July 1 scene date.
